mapper.sql: select c.consultant_id, c.user_id, u.nick_name, cast(c.countries as text) as countries, cast(c.degrees as text) as degrees, c.max_active, case when u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' then c.accepting else 'N' end as accepting, c.last_assigned_time, (select count(*) from abr_lead l where l.owner_user_id = c.user_id and l.merged_into is null and l.del_flag = '0' and l.stage not in ('won', 'lost')) as active_count, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from abr_consultant c left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into abr_consultant (user_id, countries, degrees, max_active, accepting, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark) values (#{userId}, cast(#{countries} as jsonb), cast(#{degrees} as jsonb), #{maxActive}, #{accepting}, #{createBy}, now(), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from abr_consultant where consultant_id in #{id}
mapper.update: update abr_consultant set last_assigned_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select s.setting_id as settingId, s.auto_assign as autoAssign, s.match_country as matchCountry, s.pick_strategy as pickStrategy, cast(s.assign_grades as text) as assignGrades, cast(s.sla_hours as text) as slaHours, s.escalate_hours as escalateHours, s.escalate_user_id as escalateUserId, u.nick_name as escalateUserName, s.update_by as updateBy, s.update_time as updateTime from abr_lead_assign_setting s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.escalate_user_id where s.setting_id = 1
mapper.update: update abr_lead_assign_setting set auto_assign = #{autoAssign}, match_country = #{matchCountry}, pick_strategy = #{pickStrategy}, assign_grades = cast(#{assignGrades} as jsonb), sla_hours = cast(#{slaHours} as jsonb), escalate_hours = #{escalateHours}, escalate_user_id = #{escalateUserId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where setting_id = 1
mapper.select: select l.lead_id as "leadId", l.grade as "grade", cast(v.profile -> 'target_countries' as text) as "countries", (select p.target_degree from abr_profile p where p.visitor_id = l.visitor_id order by p.profile_id desc limit 1) as "degree" from abr_lead l left join abr_visitor v on v.visitor_id = l.visitor_id where l.owner_user_id is null and l.merged_into is null and l.del_flag = '0' and l.stage not in ('won', 'lost') and l.grade in #{g} order by case l.grade when 'A' then 1 when 'B' then 2 else 3 end, l.last_touch_time desc limit #{limit}

select lead_id as "leadId", owner_user_id as "ownerUserId", display_name as "displayName", grade as "grade", sla_due_time as "slaDueTime" from abr_lead where sla_status = 'pending' and sla_due_time < #{now} and first_contact_time is null and merged_into is null and stage not in ('won', 'lost') order by sla_due_time limit 200

select lead_id as "leadId", owner_user_id as "ownerUserId", display_name as "displayName", grade as "grade", sla_due_time as "slaDueTime" from abr_lead where sla_status = 'overdue' and sla_due_time < #{before} and first_contact_time is null and merged_into is null and stage not in ('won', 'lost') order by sla_due_time limit 200
mapper.update: update abr_lead set sla_status = #{to}, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId} and sla_status = #{from}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_staff_notice (user_id, notice_kind, title, content, lead_id, dedup_key, channel_result, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{noticeKind}, #{title}, coalesce(#{content}, ''), #{leadId}, #{dedupKey}, coalesce(#{channelResult}, ''), now()) on conflict (user_id, dedup_key) where dedup_key is not null do nothing
mapper.select: select notice_id as noticeId, user_id as userId, notice_kind as noticeKind, title, content, lead_id as leadId, read_flag as readFlag, read_time as readTime, channel_result as channelResult, create_time as createTime from abr_staff_notice where user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = 'N' order by notice_id desc limit 200
select count(*) from abr_staff_notice where user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = 'N'
